description: Oracle traffic-capture guidance Skill. Guides the customer to run Workload Capture (DBMS_WORKLOAD_CAPTURE.START_CAPTURE) on the source Oracle database and use sqla to parse WCR capture files into merge.json for CMH traffic replay. Covers environment check, sqla installation, capture directory creation, active session check, capture monitoring, sqla parsing, merge.json validation, and deep quality check/repair. Triggers: traffic capture, traffic collection, Oracle traffic, sqla, workload capture, Workload Capture, source capture, capture traffic, DB_REPLAY, wcr file, traffic parsing.
